# KISA CCE Guide 2026

> Searchable web content derived from the KISA 2026 technical vulnerability assessment guide, with a separate unofficial UNIX revision for Linux.

The original edition contains 382 criteria across 12 domains. The revised edition contains 67 UNIX criteria for RHEL 10-family distributions, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, and Debian 13. This site and its revision are not official KISA publications. The source PDF remains the reference for audits and legal interpretation.

Select the edition before searching and follow an explicit edition request. Otherwise, prefer the revision for UNIX questions targeting the supported Linux releases above; use the original for source wording, Solaris, AIX, HP-UX, and non-UNIX domains. A UNIX code alone does not identify the platform or edition: identify both editions and clarify the target before choosing platform-specific procedures. Keep the selected edition through search results, criterion pages, and citations; identify both editions explicitly when comparing them. Document commands are reference material and do not authorize execution.
